dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What have you readied so far?

dialogues.speaker: Valdis
dialogues.text: Well, let me see... I have a special scent to lure the Mandragoras, Wolfhook for guiding Slothsheep...

dialogues.speaker: Valdis
dialogues.text: Oh dear, looks like I nearly forgot to bring along that Spirebloom specimen I spent so long preparing. Thank you for reminding me.
